source: US House Clerk financial disclosures + US Senate eFD (annual reports)
note: Net worth is a DERIVED ESTIMATE, not a reported figure. Disclosure law requires only bracketed ranges, so each member's netWorthLow/netWorthHigh are the summed bracket bounds (assets minus liabilities) and netWorth is their midpoint. Spouse and joint holdings are included; an open-ended top bracket is counted at one dollar above its threshold. Refresh every 90 days and after the mid-May filing deadline.
